question: Do the first-party VISION3 50D, 250D and 500T high-frequency MTF shapes supply a stock-distinguishing physical source-domain signature after their characteristic-shape bank closed?

comparison.metric: RMSE of natural-log MTF response after subtracting the per-channel value at 25 cycles/mm
comparison.interpolation: linear in log10 spatial frequency and natural-log response
comparison.negative_control: the exact P2T characteristic-shape decision must remain closed

allowed_after_pass: retain a three-stock source-domain MTF signature as a physical FilmProfileBundle prior
freeze a separate joint characteristic-MTF profile compiler that keeps illuminant and graph identities explicit
forbidden: change any trace point, stock, channel, frequency, metric or gate after pairwise scoring
infer a digital RGB colour operator, real roll response, scanner response or calibrated stock appearance
render photographs, train a router or alter the current B0/AO6 product default
use a single material channel or only two stock pairs to claim a three-stock bank
treat manufacturer typical curves as uncertainty-free measurements

branch_rule.pass: Retain source-domain MTF diversity and open only a separately frozen joint physical-prior compiler.
branch_rule.fail: Close these exact VISION3 MTF traces without threshold, trace, stock, frequency or normalization rescue and return to new measured film evidence.

claim_ceiling: First-party manufacturer-graph source-domain MTF diversity for three VISION3 stocks; not a roll, process, scanner, colour-response, look, calibrated profile or product operator.
